contexts.text: Ground, and field () = the external man when he is becoming celestial.
Field is a term which is applied to the Church, or to a regenerate man.
Field = doctrine, thus whatever belongs to the doctrine concerning faith and charity. Illustrated. AC 382:2.
Doctrine is called a field from the seed.
As a field = doctrine, whoever receives any seed of faith is called a field; whether man, the Church, or the world.
Fields are predicated of goods and evils. Illustrated.
The field = the Church, being so called from the seed which it receives; thus those are in the field () = those who are in the good of doctrine.
He who is in the field () = those who are in the Spiritual Church.
At the end of the field () = where there is little of the Church. A field = the Church; and also doctrine which is of the Church. AC 2946. AC 2954. AC 2969.

The field and the cave which is in it () = as to the good and truth of faith. A field = the Church, and also the good itself which is of the Church. What is celestial, that is, the good which is of love to the Lord and of charity towards the neighbour, is compared to ground, and also to a field... because what is celestial, or good, is what receives the truths of faith, which are compared to seeds.
A field = the good of faith.

Isaac went out to meditate in the field () = a state of the Rational in good... A field = doctrine and the things which belong to doctrine, thus the things which are of the Church as to good. This was the origin of the ancient saying to meditate in the field, signifying to think in good...
A man of the field () = the good of life from doctrinal things. AC 3310:3, Explained.
See Earth.

As the Church is not the Church from doctrinal things, except in so far as they have the good of life as the end; or, what is the same thing, unless the doctrinal things are conjoined with the good of life; therefore, by a field is principally signified the good of life.

That a field = the good of life, in which are implanted the things which are of faith, that is, the spiritual truths which are of the Church (is evident from the parable of the sower). It here treats of four kinds of ground in the field, that is, in the Church... and it is evident that the good earth is the good of charity; for it is the good in man which receives the Word.
Esau came from the field () = the study of the good of life... To come from the field = the study of good; for to meditate in the field = to think in good.
Go into the field () = where there is good ground. A field = the good of the Church; and also the good of doctrine. References. AC 3508.

As the smell of a field () = as from good ground from which comes truth. The smell of a field = the perception of truth from good, like the exhalation from the harvest in a field. A field = good ground.

He who is in the field, let him not turn back to take his garment = that those who are in the good of truth must not betake themselves from the good to the doctrine of truth. A field, in the Word, = that state of man as to good.

There are three kinds of men within the Church: they who are in love to the Lord, they who are in charity towards the neighbour, and they who are in the affection of truth... The third class... are in special signified by He who is in the field let him not turn back to take his garment.
In a field () = for Churches. A field = the Church as to good.

The Church is signified by land, ground, and field, but with a difference. The reason a field = the Church, is that, like a field, the Church receives the seeds of good and truth... Hence whatever was in a field also, signified that which belongs to the Church; as a harvest, standing corn, wheat, barley, etc. AC 3941:3. AC 5295.
Those who fear nothing of evil, because they are in truths and goods, which is to be in the heights of the field ().

Mandrakes in the field () = the things of marriage love in the truth and good of charity and love... Field = the Church; thus the truth of faith and the good of charity, because these make the Church. References.
Jacob came from the field in the evening () = the good of truth in a state of good, but in obscurity... Field = the Church as to good, thus good.
A field = the things which are of good, and where good is.
Under Edom, see this reference.

Then shall two be in the field, the one shall be taken, and the other left () = those within the Church who are in good, and those within the Church who are in evil; that those who are in good will be saved, and those who are in evil condemned. The field = the Church as to good. References.
He bought a portion of a field () = the appropriation of good from that truth... A field = the Church as to good, thus good. References.
His sons were with his substance in the field () = that his descendants were in their own religiosity... A field = the Church... For such a kind of Church is to be called a religiosity. AC 4443.
A field = the Church as to good, thus the good of the Church. AC 4717. AC 6432:6. AC 9139. AC 9142. AC 9146. AC 9230. AC 9262:3. AC 9294.
The field () = the truth which is of doctrine. AC 4982.

When the celestial man is treated of... field = spiritual good... which is the good of charity towards the neighbour: but when the spiritual man is treated of... field = the Spiritual with him, which is the truth of faith.
A field () = good.

The Egyptians sold everyone his field () = the renunciation and subjection of all things which are of service to the Church... A field = the doctrine which is of the Church; and, in a general sense, the Church.

For seed of the field () = for the nourishment of the mind... Field, in a general sense, = the Church; and, in particular, the Church with man, thus the man in whom is the Church, that is, who receives truth and good: when he is called a field it is his mind which is meant...
A field = the Church, thus the man of the Church, for he is a Church.
In all service in the field () = the intention of subjugation against the things of the Church.
The fields () = things still more general, thus still more exterior; for the fields are outside the houses and the courts.

The reason field = the Church, is that the seeds which are put into a field = the truths of faith; and also because the produce of a field, as wheat, barley, etc. = the goods of charity and the truths of faith; thus such things as are of the Church.
Left... in the field () = not stored up and reserved.

This day ye shall not mind it in the field () = that no longer is there acquired good through truth... The field = man; here, the mind of man in which is implanted good through truth; for man is called a field from the fact that he receives the truths of faith... and produces goods.

This signification of a field and a vineyard originates in the representatives of the Spiritual World; for fields full of wheat and barley appear before Spirits when the Angels in Heaven above them are discoursing about a congregation who are in good...

And shall desolate in the field of another () = the consumption of cohering goods... In the field of another = cohering goods; for a field = the Church; and the things which are in the field are goods; thus the things which are in the field of another = the near goods which cohere...
Woods from the field () = the interior goods of the Church.
Ye shall not eat flesh torn to pieces in a field () = that the good of the Church, or the good of faith, falsified, must not be appropriated or conjoined.
One who is pierced in the land lying in a field () = truth and good extinguished in the Church where good is.

The reason is, that all things belonging to a field... = such things as are of the Church in general, and of the man of the Church in particular, who is a man regenerated through truth of faith and good of charity by the Lord: hence it is that field and ground = those in the Church who receive the truths and goods of faith, as a field does seeds... These are real correspondences; for when the Angels are discoursing about the regeneration of man by the Lord through the truths of faith and the goods of charity, in the World of Spirits below there appear fields, crops, fallow lands, and also harvests; and this because they correspond. He who knows this, may also know that such things in this world have been created according to correspondences... From this it is evident whence it is that the things which belong to a field, that is, which are sown in a field and reaped from a field, signify such things as are of the Church in general and in particular. AC 10669:3.

The field, in which the harvest is, in a wide sense, = the whole human race, that is, the whole world; in a sense less wide, the Church; in a narrower sense, the man of the Church; and in a still narrower sense, the good which is in the man of the Church, for this receives the truths of faith, as a field does the seed... The field is the world.
In thy gathering thy works from the field () = the enjoyment and use of all things which are implanted in good.
It is said wild honey, because a field = the Church.
In the fields of the wood () = in the natural or literal sense of the Word. References.
The fields of the wood = the goods of the Church among the gentiles.
(Thus) a field = the Church as to the reception of truth; and land, the Church as to the reception of good.
Fields white for the harvest (seen in the Fifth Earth).
As it were fields and harvests (are there presented to the view of those who have loved Divine truths and the Word from interior affection).
A field = the Church as to good and the truth thence derived.
Comparison with the preparation of a field.
A field = doctrine.
Comparison with a field in which treasure is hidden.
I dreamed of a field. (See Euphrates.)
Two in the field = those in the Church who apply truths and goods to themselves.
To buy fields with silver () = to acquire for themselves the good of the Church by means of truths.
A field of sowing () = the good from which (truth) grows.
A field = the good of the Church.
The trees of the field = the Church as to the Knowledges of truth.
The good seed which the man sowed in the field = the truths of the Church which are from good; the field = the Church where they are.
A field = the Church, from the reception of truth; and the earth = the Church from the perception of good.
Fields correspond to all things of the Church.
A vineyard = the Church as to truth; and a field, the Church as to good. AE 730:8.
A field = the Church, from sowing, and from the reception of the seeds.
Fields = all the goods and truths of the Church.
A field () means the Spiritual World and the Church, where there are both the good and the evil. AE 426:3. ( = the Church where the Word is. AE 911:3.)
The heights of a field () = the interior things of the Church, from which there is combat. AE 447:4.
The wild beasts of the fields = the nations who are in the good of life.
Fields = doctrinal things from the Word.
Fields = the Church as to the implantation of the truth of doctrine.
The fields of the forest = the Natural of the Word.
The field () = where there are truths and goods in abundance.
A field = the Church where truth is first implanted, afterwards grows, and at last becomes of doctrine.
The field is the world = the Church everywhere.
The Church is described by... a field, from its produce, by which man is nourished.
